Us samay Sanskrit shiksha ke mahatva par kuchh log sawal uthate the ki yeh vyavaharik drishti se kam upyogi hai, lekin iski shikshik tatha maanviya mahatta ko nkar nahi kiya ja sakta. Sanskrit gyaan ne samkalin European vidwanon ko bhi prabhavit kiya tatha Adam ne apni report me Sanskrit sahitya ko prachinata ki sabse bahumulya smritiyon me se ek batate hue kaha ki yeh pashchimi Asia tatha Europe ke lagbhag har log ke itihas se jude sambandhon ko darshata hai. Exam point: Dakshin Bihar ke do Sanskrit shikshak - Chakrapani Pandit tatha Hara Lal Pandit - lekhak ke roop me bhi jaane jaate the, jo us samay ke Sanskrit vidvanon ki sahityik gatividhi ko darshata hai.

qe: Which ruler of Bihar paid attention to the education of the Pandits in his estates, being himself a Brahmin of very high birth?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा शासक, स्वयं अत्यंत उच्च जन्म का ब्राह्मण होने के कारण, अपनी जागीरों के पंडितों की शिक्षा पर ध्यान देता था?
e: Shiksha ki nayi vyavastha se do sau saal pehle ki sthiti dekhi jaaye to pata chalta hai ki shiksha rajya ke niyantran me nahi thi, balki vyaktigat sanrakshan tatha paropkar par nirbhar thi. Darbhanga ke Raja, jo svayan bahut uncha janm liye hue Brahman the, apni riyasat ke panditon ki shiksha par dhyan dete the. Is tarah ke sanrakshan se purani shiksha parampara zinda rahi. Unnisvin sadi ki shuruat tak do prakar ki sansthayen maujud thin - uchcha shiksha ki sansthayen, jo Sanskrit ya Persian tatha Arabic ke madhyam se padhati thin, tatha prarambhik shiksha ki sansthayen; Sanskrit sansthanon me visheshagya shiksha hoti thi tatha vibhinn sthanon par vidvan shikshak kaam karte the. Exam point: Darbhanga ke Raja apni riyasat ke panditon ki shiksha par dhyan dete the, jo us samay shiksha ke vyaktigat sanrakshan tatha paropkar par nirbhar hone ka udaharan hai.

qe: A mid-eighteenth century historian of Bihar recorded that in Azimabad (Patna) and its environs there were how many professors of repute, along with three or four hundred students and disciples?
qh: बिहार के एक मध्य-अठारहवीं सदी के इतिहासकार ने लिखा कि आज़ीमाबाद (पटना) तथा उसके आसपास तीन-चार सौ विद्यार्थियों सहित कितने ख्यातिप्राप्त प्रोफेसर थे?
e: Aadhaar sadi ke madhya me Bihar me Persian shiksha ka bahut vistar tha. Azimabad yaani aaj ka Patna us samay Persian shiksha ka ek mahatvapurn kendra tha. Us samay ke ek itihasakar ne likha ki un dinon Azimabad me vigyan tatha vidya se prem karne wale kai vyakti the, jo padhane tatha padhne me lage rehte the; unhone shehar tatha uske aas-paas nau ya das khyaatiprapt professor yaani adhyapak tatha teen-char sau vidyarthi tatha shishya dekhe the. Is vivran se andaza lagta hai ki us samay bade shahron tatha door-daraz ke ilakon me kitne vidya-kendra rahe honge. Isi samay Iran se Persian me nipun kai vidvan Bharat aaye tatha vishesh roop se Bihar tatha Patna me bas gaye, jisse yahan ki shiksha tatha sanskriti aur samriddh hui. Exam point: Madhya atharahvin sadi me Azimabad yaani Patna Persian shiksha ka mahatvapurn kendra tha, jahan ek samkalin itihasakar ke varnan me nau ya das khyaatiprapt professor tatha teen-char sau vidyarthi the.

qe: It was noted at the time of the survey that the schools for Persian education in Bihar were nearly as much frequented by Hindus as by Muhammadans, mainly because knowledge of Persian was considered necessary for those who wished to acquire fortune in which field?
qh: बुकानन ने लिखा कि बिहार में फारसी शिक्षा के विद्यालयों में हिंदू लगभग उतने ही आते थे जितने मुहम्मदन; इसका मुख्य कारण यह था कि फारसी का ज्ञान उन लोगों के लिए आवश्यक माना जाता था जो किस क्षेत्र में भाग्य आज़माना चाहते थे?
e: Us samay Persian bhasha sarkari bhasha yaani official language thi, isliye uska gyaan vyavaharik aavashyakta ban gaya tha. Us samay yah bhi dekha gaya ki Persian shiksha ke schoolon me Hindu lagbhag utne hi aate the jitne Muhammadan, kyunki Persian bhasha ko har bade aadmi yaani gentleman ke liye ek zaroori gun maana jaata tha tatha un logon ke liye bilkul aavashyak thi jo adalaton yaani courts of law me apna bhavishya banana chahte the. Isi karan Hindu vidyarthiyon ki sankhya Persian schoolon me kaafi thi. Persian shiksha ka vistaar is baat ka pramaan hai ki us samay ki shiksha vyavaharik zarooraton tatha rozgaar ke avsaron se judi hui thi, aur raj-kaj yaani administration ki bhasha seekhna logon ke liye labhdayak maana jaata tha. Exam point: Persian schoolon me Hindu itne hi aate the kyunki Persian official bhasha thi tatha un logon ke liye aavashyak thi jo adalaton yaani courts of law me safalta tatha bhavishya banana chahte the.

qe: At the time of the survey, the districts of South Bihar had 291 schools of Persian and Arabic learning; how many of these were schools of Persian education?
qh: सर्वेक्षण के समय दक्षिण बिहार के जिलों में फारसी तथा अरबी शिक्षा के 291 विद्यालय थे; इनमें से कितने फारसी शिक्षा के विद्यालय थे?
e: Adam ke samay dakshin Bihar ke zilon me kul 291 school the, jinme 279 Persian tatha barah yaani 12 Arabic shiksha ke the. In schoolon ki sankhya tatha shikshakon ki sankhya barabar thi yaani pratyek school me ek shikshak tha, tatha kul vidyarthiyon ki sankhya 1,496 thi. In vidyarthiyon me 1,424 Persian tatha 62 Arabic ke vidyarthi the; Persian ke vidyarthiyon me 865 Hindu the, jabki Arabic ke vidyarthiyon me do Hindu the, jo Kayastha jaati ke the. Yeh aankde dikhate hain ki Persian tatha Arabic shiksha ka apna alag vistaar tha tatha Arabic ki tulna me Persian shiksha zyada lokpriya thi, kyunki Persian raj-kaj ki bhasha thi. Exam point: Adam ke samay dakshin Bihar ke 291 schoolon me se 279 Persian tatha 12 Arabic shiksha ke the, tatha kul vidyarthi 1,496 the, jinme 865 Hindu Persian vidyarthi tatha Arabic ke keval do Hindu vidyarthi the.

qe: In the district of Tirhut, of the Persian scholars, how many were Hindus, as against 126 who were Mussalmans?
qh: तिरहुत जिले में फारसी विद्यार्थियों में 126 मुसलमानों के मुकाबले कितने हिंदू थे?
e: Adam ke samay Tirhut zile me bhi shiksha ka achha vistar tha. Wahan 254 school the, jinme 238 Persian tatha char Arabic the. Tirhut zile me 569 Persian tatha 29 Arabic vidyarthi the. In Persian vidyarthiyon me 126 Mussalman Mohammadan yaani Muslim the tatha 443 Hindu the, yaani Persian padhne wale vidyarthiyon ki badi sankhya Hindu thi. Har zile me Persian shikshakon me ek Hindu shikshak hota tha tatha baaki Mussalman shikshak hote the. Yeh sthiti dikhati hai ki Persian shiksha keval Muhammadan samuday tak seemit nahi thi; raj-kaj tatha adalaton ki bhasha hone ke karan Hindu vidyarthi bhi ise bade paimane par padhte the, isliye Tirhut me Persian vidyarthiyon me Hindu bahusankhyak the. Exam point: Tirhut zile ke 569 Persian vidyarthiyon me 126 Mussalman tatha 443 Hindu the, jabki 29 Arabic vidyarthi the; isse saaf hai ki Persian shiksha me Hindu vidyarthiyon ki sankhya kaafi zyada thi.

qe: In the estimate of 1835, Bengal and Bihar together had about one lakh indigenous elementary schools; assuming a population of four crore, there was a village school for every how many persons?
qh: 1835 के अनुमान के अनुसार बंगाल तथा बिहार में मिलाकर लगभग एक लाख देशी प्रारंभिक विद्यालय थे; चार करोड़ जनसंख्या मानते हुए, कितने व्यक्तियों पर एक गाँव का विद्यालय था?
e: Unnisvin sadi ke chhoti dashak me Bihar-Bengal me desi tatha gaon ke school yaani indigenous elementary schools ki sankhya bahut badi thi. Adam ke anumaan ke mutabik 1835 me Bengal tatha Bihar me lagbhag ek lakh (100,000) indigenous prarambhik school the. Yadi in dono pranton ki jansankhya char crore (40,000,000) maani jaaye, to har 400 vyaktiyon par ek gaon ka school yaani village school hota tha. Iska arth hai ki pratyek chhote se chhote kshetra me shiksha ka ek sthan tha tatha samaj me padhne-likhne ka prachar kaafi vyapak tha. Isi vignapan se saaf hota hai ki angrezi shiksha ki nayi vyavastha shuru hone se pehle yahan desi shiksha ka ek bada jaal maujud tha. Exam point: 1835 ke anumaan ke mutabik Bengal tatha Bihar me lagbhag ek lakh desi prarambhik school the; char crore jansankhya maan kar lagbhag har 400 vyaktiyon par ek gaon ka school tha.

qe: In the eighteen subdivisions of the district of Purnea, how many elementary schools were found among the Hindu population, though the number was considered very inadequate to the demand?
qh: पूर्णिया जिले के अठारह उपविभागों में बुकानन को हिंदू आबादी के बीच कितने प्रारंभिक विद्यालय मिले, जिन्हें उन्होंने माँग के अनुसार बहुत ही अपर्याप्त माना?
e: Purnea zile ke atharah upvibhagon yaani subdivisions me Hindu aabadi ke beech 643 prarambhik school yaani elementary schools mile. Yeh sankhya maang yaani demand ke hisab se bahut hi aparyapt yaani inadequate maani gayi, kyunki zile ki badi aabadi ke liye itne school kam the. Phir bhi isse pata chalta hai ki padhai ka prachar gaon-gaon tak tha; zile ke bahut se log apne maata-pita se padhna-likhna seekhte the. Adhikansh vidyalay us samay desi dhang se chalte the, jinme padhane wale shikshak gaon ke hi log hote the. Isi tarah ke aankdon se pata chalta hai ki us samay shiksha ka koi kendrikrit yaani centralized prabandh nahi tha, balki gaon tatha samuday ke star par hi padhai-hotee thi. Exam point: Purnea zile ke atharah upvibhagon me Buchanan ko Hindu aabadi ke beech 643 prarambhik school mile, jine unhone maang ke mukable bahut aparyapt bataya, halanki isse gaon-gaon me padhai ke prachar ka pata chalta hai.

qe: In Adam's time the nine thanas of the district of South Bihar contained 285 Hindi schools; of the Hindu teachers of these schools, how many were Kayasthas?
qh: एडम के समय दक्षिण बिहार जिले के नौ थानों में 285 हिंदी विद्यालय थे; इन विद्यालयों के हिंदू शिक्षकों में कितने कायस्थ थे?
e: Adam ke samay dakshin Bihar zile ke nau thanon me kul 285 Hindi school the. In schoolon ke shikshakon me ek shikshak Mussalman tha tatha baaki Hindu the. Hindu shikshakon me 278 Kayastha, do Magadha, ek Gandhabanik, ek Teli, ek Koiri tatha ek Sonar jaati ke the; isse saaf hai ki prarambhik Hindi schoolon ke shikshakon me Kayastha jaati ka prabhutva tha. In schoolon ke vidyarthiyon me 172 Mussalman tatha 2,918 Hindu the. Hindu vidyarthi alag-alag unchi tatha nichli jaatiyon se aate the, yaani in schoolon me jaati ke aadhar par pravesh ka koi sakht niyam nahi tha. Yeh tathy us samay ki shiksha-vyavastha ki samajik khoobi darshata hai. Exam point: Dakshin Bihar zile ke nau thanon ke 285 Hindi schoolon ke Hindu shikshakon me 278 Kayastha the, jabki vidyarthiyon me 172 Mussalman tatha 2,918 Hindu the, jo alag-alag unchi-nichli jaatiyon se the.

qe: Which notable feature of the indigenous institutions of primary education in Bihar is recorded at the time of the survey?
qh: सर्वेक्षण के समय बिहार की देशी प्रारंभिक शिक्षा संस्थाओं की कौन-सी उल्लेखनीय विशेषता दर्ज की गई है?
oe: Only Persian was taught in them
Girls were never taught in any of them
They maintained teachers and students irrespective of caste or creed
Only Brahmana boys were admitted to them
oh: इनमें केवल फारसी पढ़ाई जाती थी
इनमें लड़कियों को कभी नहीं पढ़ाया जाता था
वे जाति या पंथ का भेद किए बिना शिक्षक तथा विद्यार्थी रखते थे
इनमें केवल ब्राह्मण लड़कों को प्रवेश मिलता था
e: Sarvekshan ke samay ki prarambhik shiksha sansthaon ki sabse ullekhniya visheshta yah thi ki yeh jaati ya panth yaani caste or creed ka bhed kiye bina shikshak tatha vidyarthi rakhti thin. Bihar me prarambhik schoolon ke shikshak mukhya roop se Kayastha jaati se liye jaate the, lekin kuchh anya jaatiyon ke tatha ek Mussalman shikshak bhi Hindi school me padhate the. Isi tarah Mussalman vidyarthi bhi Hindi schoolon me padhte the. Adhikansh schoolon me yahi pattern tha. Iska arth hai ki us samay ki desi shiksha-vyavastha samaj ke alag-alag vargon tatha dharmon ke logon ko ek jagah padhane ka kaam karti thi, jo us samay ke samaj me ek mahatvapurn tathy hai. Exam point: Desi prarambhik shiksha sansthaen jaati tatha panth ka bhed kiye bina shikshakon tatha vidyarthiyon ko rakhti thin; ek Mussalman shikshak Hindi school me padhata tha tatha Mussalman vidyarthi bhi Hindi schoolon me padhte the.

qe: Where were the schools for higher learning as well as for primary education mostly accommodated in Bihar at the time of the survey?
qh: सर्वेक्षण के समय बिहार में उच्च शिक्षा तथा प्रारंभिक शिक्षा के विद्यालय अधिकतर कहाँ चलाए जाते थे?
oe: In thatched houses built by the teachers themselves on land donated by local persons
In stone mansions built by the Government
Only in the premises of temples and mosques
In market buildings rented by the panchayats
oh: उन झोपड़ीनुमा घरों में जिन्हें शिक्षक स्वयं बनाते थे तथा जिनकी भूमि स्थानीय प्रतिष्ठित व्यक्ति दान करते थे
सरकार द्वारा बनाए गए पक्के भवनों में
केवल मंदिरों तथा मस्जिदों के परिसरों में
पंचायतों द्वारा किराए पर लिए बाजार के भवनों में
e: Sarvekshan ke samay uchcha shiksha tatha prarambhik shiksha ki sansthayen adhiktar chhappar wale yaani thatched gharon me chalti thin, jo shikshak svayan banate the. Aise gharon ki zameen gaon ke pratishthit tatha sampann vyaktiyon dwara daan ki jaati thi. Kuchh sthanon par school ke liye koi bhawan hi nahi hota tha; aise sthaanon par kakshayen doosron ke gharon ke baahar wale hisson ya bagichon me lagti thin. Isse pata chalta hai ki us samay shiksha-vyavastha sarkari bhawanon tatha bade budget par nahi, balki sthanik sahyog tatha shikshak ke svayan ke prayas par chal rahi thi. Yahi karan hai ki yeh vyavastha sthanik aavashyaktaon ke hisab se lachili yaani flexible thi, lekin saadhan seemit hone ke karan iska vistar bhi seemit tha. Exam point: Uchcha tatha prarambhik shiksha ki sansthaen adhiktar shikshakon dwara svayan banaye gaye chhappar wale gharon me chalti thin, jinki zameen sthanik pratishthit vyaktiyon ne daan ki hoti thi; kuchh sthanon par bhawan hi nahi the.

qe: What was the average monthly professional income of the village schoolmasters of Bengal and Bihar at the time of the survey?
qh: सर्वेक्षण के समय बंगाल तथा बिहार के गाँवों के अध्यापकों की औसत मासिक आय क्या थी?
e: Sarvekshan ke mutabik Bengal tatha Bihar me gaon ke schoolmaster yaani adhyapakon ki ausat maasik aay lagbhag teen rupaye thi. Yeh aay bahut kam thi, lekin iske saath-saath unhe varshik tyoharon tatha anya avsaron par khane-peene ki cheejen tatha kapde ke roop me kuchh inaam yaani presents bhi milte the, jisse unki aay kuchh badh jaati thi. Ek santosh ki baat yah thi ki gaon ke adhyapak samaj me bahut samman yaani social prestige prapt karte the. Unhe shiksha ke prasar ka ek mahatvapurn aadhaar maana jaata tha, kyunki gaon ke bachchon ko padhaana tatha likhawat sikhaana inhi ke bharose tha. Isse pata chalta hai ki us samay ke shikshak aarthik roop se kamzor hone ke bawajood samajik roop se prabhavshali sthan rakhte the. Exam point: Gaon ke adhyapakon ki ausat maasik aay lagbhag teen rupaye thi, jise tyoharon par mile tohfon se kuchh sahayata milti thi; iske bawajood samaj me unhe samman tatha uncha sthan prapt tha.

qe: The Resolution of 7 March 1835, declaring that all funds appropriated for purposes of education would be best employed on English education alone, was passed by the Government of which Governor-General?
qh: 7 मार्च 1835 के उस प्रस्ताव, जिसमें घोषित किया गया कि शिक्षा के लिए दिए गए सभी धन केवल अंग्रेजी शिक्षा पर लगाना सर्वोत्तम होगा, को किस गवर्नर-जनरल की सरकार ने पारित किया?
e: Angrezi shiksha ke aarambh ka itihas vicharon ki takkar se juda hai. Company ki sarkar pehle bhartiya samajik tatha shikshik maamlon me dakhal nahi deti thi tatha laissez-faire yaani kuchh na karne ki niti apnati thi. Lekin 1813 me Company ke Charter yaani adhikar-patr ke navikaran ke samay British Parliament ne Company se kaha ki woh upyogi gyaan tatha dharmik-moral sudhar ke liye kadam utaye. Uske baad Orientalists tatha Anglicists ke beech bahas chali ki kis prakar ki shiksha di jaaye. Anglicists pashchimi dhang se angrezi madhyam me udar shiksha ke pakshdhar the. Macaulay, jo 1834 me naye Law Member ke roop me Bharat aaye, Committee of Public Instruction ke President niyukt hue; unki raay, jo 2 February 1835 ke minute me likhi hai, ke aadhaar par Lord William Bentinck ki sarkar ne 7 March 1835 ka prasiddh prastav yaani Resolution paarit kiya, jisme kaha gaya ki shiksha ke liye diye gaye sabhi dhan angrezi shiksha par hi kharch karna sarvottam hoga. Exam point: 7 March 1835 ka prastav, jisme shiksha ke sabhi dhan angrezi shiksha par lagane ki baat kahi gayi, Lord William Bentinck ki sarkar ne paarit kiya tha; yah Macaulay ke 2 February 1835 ke minute ke aadhaar par hua.

qe: Macaulay, who came to India in 1834 as the new Law Member, was appointed President of which body, whose opinion he embodied in his minute of 2 February 1835?
qh: 1834 में नए लॉ मेंबर के रूप में भारत आए मैकॉले को किस निकाय का अध्यक्ष नियुक्त किया गया था, जिसकी राय उन्होंने 2 फरवरी 1835 के अपने मिनट में व्यक्त की?
e: Macaulay 1834 me Company ke naye Law Member ke roop me Bharat aaye. Unhe Committee of Public Instruction yaani lok shiksha samiti ka President banaya gaya. Unka vichar unke 2 February 1835 ke prasiddh minute me darj hai, jisme unhone angrezi madhyam se pashchimi vidya yaani western education dene ka samarthan kiya. Isi minute ke aadhaar par 7 March 1835 ka prastav aaya, jisme shiksha ke dhan angrezi shiksha par kharch karne ki baat kahi gayi. Unnisvin sadi ke pehle dashakon me is vishay par tikhi bahas chali - Orientalists prachin bhashaon tatha Sanskrit-Persian shiksha ko mahatva dena chahte the, aur Anglicists angrezi tatha pashchimi gyaan ke paksh me the. Anglicists ki raay ant me bhari pad gayi tatha Bihar sahit poore desh me angrezi shiksha ka rasta khul gaya. Exam point: Macaulay ko Committee of Public Instruction yaani lok shiksha samiti ka President banaya gaya tha tatha unhone apni raay 2 February 1835 ke minute me rakhi, jiske aadhaar par angrezi shiksha ka prastav aaya.

qe: Which Zila schools were the first English schools established in Bihar under Government auspices, along with the Hill School at Bhagalpur?
qh: बिहार में सरकारी संरक्षण में स्थापित पहले अंग्रेजी विद्यालय कौन-से जिला विद्यालय थे, जिनके साथ भागलपुर का हिल स्कूल भी था?
e: Angrezi shiksha ke prasar ke saath Bihar me Company sarkar dwara schoolon ki sthapna shuru hui. Purnea me angrezi shiksha ka ek school 1835 ke shuru me hi shuru ho chuka tha. Bihar me do shiksha-vritt yaani education circles shuru kiye gaye - ek Bihar me tatha doosra Bhagalpur me. Jald hi Zila schools Patna me sthapit hue, jo sarkari sanrakshan yaani Government auspices me Bihar ke pehle angrezi school the; iske alava Arrah tatha Chapra me tatha Bhagalpur me Hill School sthaapit hue. Bhagalpur me ek anya school, jise Bhagalpur Institution kaha gaya, bhi shuru kiya gaya. In schoolon ke sthaapan se Bihar me angrezi tatha aadhunik vishayon ki padhai ka rasta khul gaya, jo aage chalkar college shiksha ke vikas ka aadhaar bana. Exam point: Bihar me sarkari sanrakshan me pehle angrezi school Zila schools ke roop me Patna me sthaapit hue; inke saath Arrah, Chapra tatha Bhagalpur ka Hill School bhi sthapit hue.

qe: In 1863, Zila schools were sanctioned for which group of places?
qh: 1863 में किन स्थानों के लिए जिला विद्यालय स्वीकृत किए गए थे?
oe: Nalanda, Rajgir, Bodh Gaya and Bihar Sharif
e: Bihar me angrezi shiksha ka vistar dhire-dhire alag-alag ilakon me hua. Patna, Arrah, Chapra tatha Bhagalpur ke Hill School jaise school pehle sthaapit kiye gaye the, jo sarkari sanrakshan me Bihar ke pehle angrezi school the. Iske baad 1863 me Deoghar, Motihari, Hazaribagh tatha Chaibasa ke liye Zila schools yaani zila vidyalaya sveekrit kiye gaye. Isi kram me aage chalkar baaki sthanon par bhi sarkari sahayata prapt tatha niji yaani aided aur private school shuru hue, jo alag-alag paristhitiyon me chalte the. Yeh vistaar dikhata hai ki angrezi shiksha pehle bade tatha prabhavshali shahron me faili tatha phir dhire-dhire naye kshetron me pahunchi. Isi kram me 1854 ke Despatch ke baad shiksha-vyavastha ko ek sanyojit roop dene ke prayas bhi shuru hue. Exam point: 1863 me Deoghar, Motihari, Hazaribagh tatha Chaibasa ke liye Zila schools sveekrit kiye gaye the, jabki Patna, Arrah, Chapra tatha Bhagalpur ke school isse pehle sthapit ho chuke the.

qe: The Despatch of 19 July 1854, which laid the foundation on which the educational system of India developed till recent times, was issued by which President of the Board of Control?
qh: 19 जुलाई 1854 का वह डिस्पैच, जिसने उस नींव को रखा जिस पर भारत की शिक्षा-व्यवस्था हाल के समय तक विकसित हुई, बोर्ड ऑफ कंट्रोल के किस अध्यक्ष द्वारा जारी किया गया था?
e: 1854 ka prasiddh Despatch yaani aadesh-patra Board of Control ke President Sir Charles Wood dwara 19 July 1854 ko jaari kiya gaya. Ise aadhunik Bharat me shiksha-vyavastha ka aadhaar maana jaata hai, kyunki isne sabse uncha star se lekar sabse nichle star tak ek sanyojit shiksha-vyavastha banane ka sujhav diya, jisme prathmik school, high school tatha college ek doosre se jude hue the tatha pratyek star ki padhai agle unche star ki tayari karati thi. Is despatch me pratyek praant me ek Department of Education yaani shiksha vibhag banane, jan-shiksha yaani mass education par zor dene, desi bhasha ki shiksha sudharne tatha shikshakon ke prashikshan yaani training ki vyavastha karne ki sifarish ki gayi. Isme yah bhi kaha gaya ki padhai ka madhyam yaani medium desi bhashayen yaani vernaculars honi chahiye. Exam point: 19 July 1854 ka Despatch Sir Charles Wood ne jaari kiya tha; isme prathmik, high school tatha college ki sanyojit vyavastha, shiksha vibhag, jan-shiksha, desi bhasha ke madhyam tatha shikshak-prashikshan ki sifarishen thin.

qe: The numerical strength of Patna College rose from five on 31 March 1863 to how many in 1881?
qh: पटना कॉलेज की संख्या 31 मार्च 1863 के पाँच से बढ़कर 1881 में कितनी हो गई थी?
e: Patna College ki sthapna ke samay, 31 March 1863 ko, isme keval paanch yaani five chhatra the. Dhire-dhire uchcha angrezi shiksha ke prati logon ka jhukav badhta gaya tatha 1881 tak college ki sankhya 162 ho gayi, yaani pahle ke mukable bahut adhik. 1868 me Patna College ke pehle batch yaani samuh ke chhatron ne apni degree prapt ki. 1882 se 1902 tak ke samay ko dheeme vistar ka kaal kaha ja sakta hai, jab chhatron ki sankhya 31 March 1881 ke 162 se badh kar 31 March 1900 ko 205 ho gayi. Is aankde se pata chalta hai ki angrezi uchcha shiksha ke prati purvagrah yaani prejudice dhire-dhire kam ho raha tha tatha Bihar ke log ise mahatva dene lage the. Exam point: Patna College ki sankhya 31 March 1863 ke paanch se badh kar 1881 me 162 ho gayi tatha 1868 me iske pehle batch ke chhatron ne degree prapt ki.

qe: The construction of which hostel of Patna College was completed in 1905?
qh: पटना कॉलेज के किस छात्रावास का निर्माण 1905 में पूरा हुआ था?
e: Beesvin sadi ke pehle dashak me Patna College ka sabhi-pakshi vikas hua; us samay ise Bengal ke Presidency College ke baad sabse mahatvapurn sarkari college maana jaata tha. Isi dauran Minto Hindu Hostel ka nirman 1905 me pura hua. Iske thodi hi der baad doosra hostel, Muhammadan Hostel (jo aaj Jackson Hostel ke naam se jaana jaata hai) banaya gaya. College parisar me purana afim yaani opium ka godown yaani warehouse ko jimnasium yaani vyayamshala me badal diya gaya tatha Principal tatha wara adhyapakon ke liye aavasiya bhavan yaani quarters ban kar 1909 tak taiyar ho gaye. In nirmannon se college me chhatron ke rehne tatha padhne ki suvidhayen kaafi badh gayin, jisse uchcha shiksha ke prati aakarshan badha. Exam point: Patna College ke Minto Hindu Hostel ka nirman 1905 me pura hua; iske baad Muhammadan Hostel (aaj Jackson Hostel) bana tatha purane afim ke godown ko jimnasium banaya gaya.

qe: The Patna College Magazine was started in March 1907 under the editorship of which professor?
qh: पटना कॉलेज मैगजीन मार्च 1907 में किस प्रोफेसर के संपादकत्व में शुरू की गई थी?
e: Beesvin sadi ke pehle dashak me Patna College ke adhyapakon me Pandit Ramavatar Sarma tatha Professor Jadunath Sarkar tatha D. N. Mallik jaise pramukh vidvan the. College ki Library ka punargathan shuru hua; 1906 me usme 5,125 granth the. July 1906 se compulsory games, drill tatha gymnastics yaani anivary khel, drill tatha vyayam ki vyavastha shuru ki gayi. Students' Common Room bana tatha College Magazine March 1907 me shuru ki gayi, jiske sampadak yaani editor Professor Jadunath Sarkar the. January 1907 me Archaeological Society yaani puratattva samiti bani, jiske pratham adhyaksh Pandit Ramavatar Sarma the; College Dramatic Society bhi usi samay bani tatha March 1909 me College Old Boys Association ka gathan hua. Exam point: Patna College ki Magazine March 1907 me Professor Jadunath Sarkar ke sampadakatva me shuru hui; January 1907 me Archaeological Society bani, jiske pehle adhyaksh Pandit Ramavatar Sarma the.

qe: With the reorganisation of 1952, which university came into being with jurisdiction over the other parts of Bihar, while Patna University was transformed into a purely teaching and residential university?
qh: 1952 के पुनर्गठन के साथ बिहार के अन्य भागों पर अधिकार क्षेत्र वाला कौन-सा विश्वविद्यालय अस्तित्व में आया, जबकि पटना विश्वविद्यालय को पूर्णतः शिक्षण तथा आवासीय विश्वविद्यालय बना दिया गया?
e: 1952 se Patna University ko ek pura shikshan tatha aavasiya vishwavidyalaya yaani purely teaching and residential university bana diya gaya, jiska seemit bhogolik adhikar-kshetra yaani territorial jurisdiction lagbhag das mil tak tha. Iska uddeshya yah tha ki vishwavidyalaya uchch koti ke anusandhan tatha mool adhyayan yaani original studies ko badhava de. Isi samay Bihar University astitva me aayi, jiska adhikar-kshetra Bihar ke baaki bhaagon par tha. Iske baad Bihar University ka bahut vistar hua tatha kai naye college sthaapit hue. Is tarah 1857 me Calcutta, Bombay tatha Madras ke baad shuru hui vishwavidyalaya-shiksha ki parampara me Bihar me 1917 (Patna University) tatha 1952 (Bihar University) do mahatvapurn padav the. Exam point: 1952 ke punargathan me Patna University shuddh shikshan tatha aavasiya vishwavidyalaya ban gayi, jabki Bihar ke anya bhaagon ke liye Bihar University astitva me aayi.

qe: Just before the outbreak of the movement of 1857-59, the Commissioner of the Patna Division arranged for the publication of a weekly Urdu newspaper, described as a most useful and important channel of instruction. What was that newspaper called?
qh: 1857-59 के आंदोलन से ठीक पहले पटना प्रमंडल के आयुक्त ने एक साप्ताहिक उर्दू समाचार-पत्र निकलवाने की व्यवस्था की, जिसे शिक्षा का अत्यंत उपयोगी तथा महत्वपूर्ण माध्यम बताया गया। उस समाचार-पत्र का नाम क्या था?
e: Jab angrez Bengal tatha Bihar me apna rajya vistar kar rahe the, tab yahan prarambhik tatha uchcha shiksha ki ek vistrit vyavastha maujud thi. 1854 ke Despatch ne aam janta tak upyogi tatha vyavaharik gyaan pahunchane ke liye sakriya kadam utane ki sifarish ki thi. 1857-59 ke andolan se thoda pehle Patna Division ke Commissioner Mr Tayler ne Government ke niyantran me desi bhasha me shiksha ke prasar ke liye kuchh upay sujhaye - jamindaron ke sahyog se tatha shikshakon ke prashikshan ke liye sabhi Sadar stations par normal schools khol kar. Shri Tayler ne Akhbar-i-Bihar naam ke ek saptahik Urdu akhbaar ke prakasahn ki bhi vyavastha ki, jise shiksha tatha suchna ka ek bahut upyogi tatha mahatvapurn madhyam bataya gaya. Is tarah akhbaar ko padhai ka sadhan maan kar us samay shiksha ka prachar dur-daraz tak pahunchane ka prayas hua. Exam point: 1857-59 ke andolan se pehle Patna Division ke Commissioner Tayler ne Akhbar-i-Bihar naam ke saptahik Urdu akhbaar ka prakasahn karaya, jise shiksha tatha suchna ka mahatvapurn madhyam maana gaya.

qe: In 1873 the Government appointed in each district a Committee of Public Instruction. Who was its President and who was its Secretary?
qh: 1873 में सरकार ने प्रत्येक जिले में लोक शिक्षा समिति नियुक्त की। उसका अध्यक्ष तथा सचिव कौन होता था?
oe: The Commissioner of the Division was President and the Magistrate-Collector was Secretary
The District Education Officer was President and the Deputy Collector was Secretary
The Commissioner of the Division was President and the District Judge was Secretary
The Magistrate-Collector was President and the Sub-Divisional Officer was Secretary
oh: प्रमंडल के आयुक्त अध्यक्ष तथा मजिस्ट्रेट-कलेक्टर सचिव
जिला शिक्षा पदाधिकारी अध्यक्ष तथा उप-कलेक्टर सचिव
प्रमंडल के आयुक्त अध्यक्ष तथा जिला न्यायाधीश सचिव
मजिस्ट्रेट-कलेक्टर अध्यक्ष तथा अनुमंडल पदाधिकारी सचिव
e: 1873 me sarkar ne pratyek jile me ek Committee of Public Instruction yaani lok shiksha samiti niyukt ki. Is samiti me executive tatha shikshik adhikari shaamil hote the; iska President Division ke Commissioner yaani pramandal ke ayukt hote the tatha Secretary Magistrate-Collector yaani mazistret-kalekshtor hote the. Is samiti ka mukhya kaam Magistrate ko shiksha se jude sabhi maamlon me salah yaani advice dena tha. Antah prashasan me Collector rajya ka mukhya raj-kaji adhikari hota hai, jo jile me bhumi-rajasv tatha kanoon-vyavastha, dono dekhata hai; use salah dene ka arth hai ki shiksha ke faisle prashasnik tatha shikshik, dono drishti se soche-samjhe hote the. Is vyavastha se jile-sthar par shiksha ke vistar ki nigrani tatha samanvay sthapit hua. Exam point: 1873 me pratyek jile me bani lok shiksha samiti ke President Division ke Commissioner tatha Secretary Magistrate-Collector hote the, jo Magistrate ko shiksha-sambandhi maamlon me salah deti thi.

qe: Which Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal, in 1875, sought to give an impetus to primary education and thought that local management of primary schools by district authorities was essential to their success?
qh: बंगाल के किस लेफ्टिनेंट-गवर्नर ने 1875 में प्रारंभिक शिक्षा को गति देने का प्रयास किया तथा माना कि प्रारंभिक विद्यालयों की सफलता के लिए जिला प्राधिकारियों द्वारा स्थानीय प्रबंधन आवश्यक है?
e: 1854 ke Despatch tatha uske baad ki nitiyon ke karan prarambhik shiksha ke vistar par zor diya jaane laga. 1875 me Bengal ke Lt-Governor Sir Richard Temple (jo 1874 se 1877 tak is pad par the) ne prarambhik shiksha ko gati dene ka prayas kiya. Unka vichar tha ki prarambhik schoolon ka local management yaani sthanik prabandhan jila adhikariyon dwara hi kiya jaana chahiye, kyunki sthanik zarooraton tatha paristhitiyon ko jila adhikari sabse achhi tarah samajhte hain - unki safalta ke liye yahi baat aavashyak maani gayi thi. Isi soch ke aage chalkar 1885 ke Local Self-Government Act ke baad District Boards ka gathan hua tatha sarkari middle tatha prarambhik schoolon ka prabandhan inke adheen kar diya gaya. Is tarah shiksha ka prabandhan dhire-dhire sthanik sansthaon ke haath me jaane laga. Exam point: 1875 me Bengal ke Lt-Governor Sir Richard Temple ne prarambhik shiksha ko gati di tatha kaha ki prarambhik schoolon ka local management jila adhikariyon dwara hona unki safalta ke liye aavashyak hai.

qe: After the passing of the Local Self-Government Act of 1885 and the formation of the District Boards, the management of which schools was transferred to their control?
qh: 1885 के स्थानीय स्वशासन अधिनियम के पारित होने तथा जिला बोर्डों के गठन के बाद किन विद्यालयों का प्रबंधन उनके नियंत्रण में स्थानांतरित कर दिया गया?
oe: All mission schools of the district
All Government middle and primary schools
oh: सभी सरकारी मध्य तथा प्रारंभिक विद्यालय
e: 1885 me Local Self-Government Act yaani sthanik svashasan adhiniyam paarit hua, jiske antargat jilon me District Boards yaani jila bord ka gathan kiya gaya. Iske baad sarkari middle tatha prarambhik schoolon ka prabandhan viksit roop se in jila bordo ke niyantran me de diya gaya. Iska arth tha ki shiksha ka prabandhan ab keval sarkari mahakma hi nahi, balki jile ki sthanik sanstha bhi dekhati thi, jisme sthanik logon ki bhaagidari tatha sthanik aavashyaktaon ko dhyan me rakhne ki gunjaish badhi. Isi samay niji udyog yaani private enterprise ne bhi madhyamik shiksha ke kshetra me kaafi pragati ki tatha sarkar ne ise protsahit kiya. Is tarah shiksha ke vistar me sarkar, jila bord tatha niji sansthaon, teeno ka yogdan badhta gaya. Exam point: 1885 ke Local Self-Government Act tatha jila bordo ke gathan ke baad sarkari middle tatha prarambhik schoolon ka prabandhan District Boards ke niyantran me chala gaya.

qe: In 1876, the Patna Division had how many primary schools with 51,346 pupils, a progress which was described as well marked?
qh: 1876 में पटना प्रमंडल में 51,346 विद्यार्थियों वाले कितने प्रारंभिक विद्यालय थे, जिसकी प्रगति को स्पष्ट रूप से उल्लेखनीय बताया गया?
e: 1876 me prarambhik shiksha ke kshetra me Patna Division me 2,149 school the, jinme 51,346 vidyarthi padhte the; government ka vichar tha ki prarambhik shiksha me pragati spasht roop se ullekhniya yaani well marked hai. Isi varsha Bhagalpur Division me aise schoolon ki sankhya 948 thi tatha unme 23,019 vidyarthi the. In aankdon se pata chalta hai ki unnisvin sadi ke antim chauthai me prarambhik shiksha ka jaal kaafi vistrit tha tatha gaon-gaon tak padhai pahunch rahi thi. Phir bhi sabhi vargon tak iska labh barabar nahi pahuncha tha; jaise aage ke vivran se pata chalta hai, sabse nichli jaatiyon ke vidyarthi is vyavastha me abhi tak poori tarah shaamil nahi ho paye the. Exam point: 1876 me Patna Division me 2,149 prarambhik school the, jinme 51,346 vidyarthi the, jabki Bhagalpur Division me 948 school tatha 23,019 vidyarthi the.

qe: The report of 1876 noted that the new pathshala system had penetrated to the middle classes of different castes, but which groups had 'only been partially reached'?
qh: 1876 के विवरण में कहा गया कि नई पाठशाला व्यवस्था विभिन्न जातियों के मध्यवर्ग तक पहुँच गई थी, लेकिन कौन-से वर्ग अभी 'आंशिक रूप से ही पहुँचे' थे?
oe: The lowest castes such as the Kahars, Dosadhs and Chamars
oh: कहार, दोसाध तथा चमार जैसी सबसे निचली जातियाँ
e: Prarambhik shiksha ke vistar ka aankalan karte samay yah dekha gaya ki nayi pathshala vyavastha yaani pathshala system alag-alag jaatiyon ke madhya-varg yaani middle classes tak pahunch gayi thi. Lekin sabse nichli jaatiyon jaise Kahars, Dosadhs tatha Chamars tak yeh vyavastha abhi tak 'keval aanshik roop se' yaani only partially hi pahunchi thi. Iske alava vidyarthiyon me Mussalman bachche kul sankhya ke keval gyarah pratishat yaani eleven per cent the. Iska arth hai ki shiksha ke vistar ke labh samaj ke sabhi vargon me barabar nahi pahunche the; unchi tatha madhya jaatiyon ke log shiksha me aage badh rahe the, jabki sabse kamzor tatha sabse nichli jaatiyon ko abhi lambi raah tay karni thi. Exam point: 1876 ke vivran me kaha gaya ki sabse nichli jaatiyan - Kahars, Dosadhs tatha Chamars jaise varg - prarambhik pathshala vyavastha se abhi keval aanshik roop se hi jude the.

qe: In the new pathshala system of 1876, Mussalman pupils formed what percentage of the total number of pupils?
qh: 1876 की नई पाठशाला व्यवस्था में मुस्लिम विद्यार्थी कुल विद्यार्थियों के कितने प्रतिशत थे?
e: 1876 ke vivran me prarambhik shiksha ke vistar ki seemayn bhi spasht hui. Us samay nayi pathshala vyavastha me Mussalman vidyarthi kul vidyarthiyon ke keval gyarah pratishat yaani eleven per cent the. Iske saath-saath yah bhi darj hua ki sabse nichli jaatiyon ke bachche is vyavastha me aanshik roop se hi pahunch paye the. Iska arth hai ki unnisvin sadi ke antim hisse me prarambhik shiksha ka vistar hua, lekin usse labh mukhya roop se madhya tatha unchi jaatiyon ke log utha rahe the; Mussalman samuday tatha nichli jaatiyon ki bhaagidari sankhya ke hisab se bahut kam thi. Yahi karan hai ki aage chalkar shiksha ke kshetra me samajik samanta laane ke liye vishesh prayas ki aavashyakta mahsoos ki gayi. Exam point: 1876 me pathshala vyavastha me Mussalman vidyarthi kul vidyarthiyon ke keval gyarah pratishat the, jo us samay shiksha ke vistar ki samajik seema darshata hai.

qe: In the Santhal Parganas, of the whole number of Santhals under instruction, 62 per cent or 1,269 persons were studying in which type of schools?
qh: संथाल परगनों में शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रहे समस्त संथालों में से 62 प्रतिशत या 1,269 व्यक्ति किस प्रकार के विद्यालयों में पढ़ रहे थे?
e: Santhal Parganas me shiksha ke vistar ki sthiti khaas thi. Us samay wahan Santhals, Paharias tatha aise hi anya samuday jansankhya ke 42 pratishat the, lekin schoolon me unki bhaagidari 35 pratishat thi. Jile ke middle ya higher schoolon me Santhal lagbhag nahi the; isliye nichle schoolon me, jisme normal boarding schools bhi shaamil the, unka pratishat 38 tak pahunch jaata tha. Kul Santhalon me se 62 pratishat yaani 1,269 Santhal mission schoolon me padh rahe the, jabki sadharan pathshalaon me unka pratishat keval 21 tha. Isliye yah sujhav diya gaya ki Santhals ki shiksha ko aage badhane tatha unhe sharab jaisi buri laton se bachane ke liye Church Missionary Society tatha Indian Home Mission ke boarding schoolon ko di jaane wali sahayata badhayi jaaye, kyunki yeh school yuva purushon ke saath-saath yuva mahilaon ko bhi prashikshit karte the. Exam point: Santhal Parganas me shiksha prapt Santhalon me 62 pratishat yaani 1,269 log mission schoolon me padhte the, jabki sadharan pathshalaon me unka hissa keval 21 pratishat tha.

qe: After the creation of the Province of Bihar and Orissa, in 1912-13 the number of schools was 23,940 with 674,286 pupils. By 1925-6 the schools had increased to how many, with how many pupils?
qh: बिहार और उड़ीसा प्रांत के गठन के बाद 1912-13 में विद्यालयों की संख्या 23,940 तथा विद्यार्थी 674,286 थे। 1925-6 तक विद्यालय कितने हो गए तथा विद्यार्थी कितने?
e: 1912 me Bihar tatha Orissa ka alag praant banne ke baad shiksha ke kshetra me tezi se vistar hua. 1912-13 me praant me schoolon ki sankhya 23,940 thi tatha unme 674,286 vidyarthi padhte the. 1925-6 tak schoolon ki sankhya badh kar 30,656 ho gayi tatha vidyarthiyon ki sankhya 930,394 ho gayi. Is vriddhi se pata chalta hai ki beesvin sadi ke pehle chauthai me prarambhik tatha madhyamik shiksha ka jaal kaafi faila. Isi dauran kuchh sthanon par nishulk tatha anivarya yaani free and compulsory shiksha bhi shuru ki gayi. Phir bhi praant me niraksharta yaani illiteracy ek bahut badi samasya bani rahi, jise door karne ke liye aage ke dashakon me vishesh karyakram chalaye gaye. Exam point: 1912-13 me praant me 23,940 school tatha 674,286 vidyarthi the, jo 1925-6 tak badh kar 30,656 school tatha 930,394 vidyarthi ho gaye.

qe: Which two notable experiments in education were inaugurated in 1937-38?
qh: 1937-38 में शिक्षा के क्षेत्र में कौन-से दो उल्लेखनीय प्रयोग शुरू किए गए?
oe: The Mass Literacy Movement and the Basic Training School at Patna
The Bihar Vidyapeeth and the National College
The Bihar School of Engineering and the Law College
The Patna Science College and the Women's Training College
oh: जन-साक्षरता आंदोलन तथा पटना का बेसिक प्रशिक्षण विद्यालय
बिहार स्कूल ऑफ इंजीनियरिंग तथा लॉ कॉलेज
पटना साइंस कॉलेज तथा महिला प्रशिक्षण महाविद्यालय
e: 1937-38 me shiksha ke kshetra me do ullekhniya prayog shuru kiye gaye. Pehla tha Mass Literacy Movement yaani jan-saksharata andolan, jiska uddeshya bade paimane par aam logon ko padhna-likhna sikhana tha. Doosra tha Patna me Basic Training School yaani besik prashikshan vidyalaya, jiska uddeshya aage chalne wale Basic-system shikshakon ko prashikshit karna tha. Jan-saksharata andolan kuchh varshon me hi apni gati kho baitha, lekin Basic system sarkar ke protsahan se aage badhta raha tatha Muzaffarpur zile ke Turki me ek rural university yaani gramin vishwavidyalaya banane ki tayari chal rahi thi. Isi samay Adivasis, Harijans tatha pichhde vargon ki shiksha ke liye vishesh vyavastha tatha suvidhayen bhi pradan ki gayin. Exam point: 1937-38 me jan-saksharata andolan tatha Patna ke Basic Training School, do ullekhniya prayog shuru hue, jinme Basic system aage badha tatha Turki (Muzaffarpur) me rural university ki yojna bani.

qe: Which research society of Bihar, created in 1915, was earlier known as the Bihar and Orissa Research Society and has a journal with an international reputation?
qh: बिहार की कौन-सी अनुसंधान संस्था 1915 में बनी थी, जो पहले बिहार और उड़ीसा रिसर्च सोसाइटी के नाम से जानी जाती थी तथा जिसकी पत्रिका को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ख्याति मिली?
e: Bihar me uchcha adhyayan tatha anusandhan yaani research ki parampara ko aage badhane me kai sansthaon ka yogdan raha hai. Inme Bihar Research Society ka naam vishesh roop se ullekhniya hai, jo 1915 me 'Bihar and Orissa Research Society' ke naam se sthapit hui thi tatha aage chalkar 'Bihar Research Society' ke naam se jaani jaane lagi. Is sanstha ne vibhinn tarikon se higher studies tatha research ko badhava diya tatha iski patrika yaani journal ko uske vidwanon dwara kiye gaye pragatisheel prakasannon ke liye antarrashtriya yaani international khyaati prapt hui. Aisi sansthaen is baat ka pramaan hain ki Bihar me gyaan ki khoj tatha rachna ki ek samriddh parampara rahi hai, jisne prant ke sanskritik tatha bauddhik jeevan ko mahatvapurn yogdan diya. Exam point: 1915 me Bihar and Orissa Research Society ke roop me sthapit sanstha aage chalkar Bihar Research Society ke naam se jaani gayi, jiski patrika ko antarrashtriya khyaati mili.

qe: The Sinha Library of Patna has as its nucleus the extensive private collection of which scholar?
qh: पटना की सिन्हा लाइब्रेरी का मूल आधार किस विद्वान के विशाल निजी संग्रह के रूप में है?
e: Patna me kitabon tatha shodh-granthon ke bade sangrah kai sansthaon me surakshit hain. Sinha Library ka mool aadhaar swargiya Dr Sachchidanand Sinha ke vistrit niji sangrah yaani private collection ko banaya gaya hai; is tarah yah library Dr Sinha ke vidwat tatha gyaan ke prati gahre prem ka ek smarak hai. Dr Sachchidanand Sinha Bihar ke ek pramukh vidwan tatha rajnitik neta the tatha unke sangrah me kitabon tatha durlabh granthon ki badi sankhya thi. Isi tarah Patna me Bihar Research Society tatha Khudabaksh Oriental Public Library jaise sansthan bhi gyaan ki parampara ko sambhal kar aage badha rahe hain. Aisi library yaani pothiyalayan tatha samgrahalay sansthaen kisi bhi praant ki bauddhik virasat ki raksha tatha uska prasar karne me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhati hain. Exam point: Sinha Library, Patna ka mool aadhaar swargiya Dr Sachchidanand Sinha ke vistrit niji sangrah se bana, jo unke vidwat tatha shodh-prem ka smarak hai.

qe: In the district of Purnea, how many women were found to understand common poetry?
qh: पूर्णिया जिले में कितनी महिलाएँ सामान्य कविता समझने वाली पाई गईं?
e: Mahilaon ki shiksha ka itihas dekhne se pata chalta hai ki prachin kaal se hi striyon me vidya ke prati rujhan raha hai. Purnea zile me 433 mahilaen aisi mili jo samanya kavita yaani common poetry samajhti thin. Shahabad zile me kuchh mahilaen aisi thi jo chitthiyan padh likh sakti thin tatha hisab-kitab samajhti thin. Isi tarah Kosi nadi ke pashchim ke kshetra me lagbhag bees mahilaen devabhasha yaani devtaon ki bhasha (Hindi) me patra-vyavahar yaani correspond kar sakti thin. Yeh tathy dikhate hain ki angrezi shiksha ke aane se pehle bhi Bharat me striyon ki ek shikshit parampara maujud thi, halanki yah sankhya seemit thi tatha unchi vargon tatha shahron me zyada thi. Exam point: Purnea zile me 433 mahilaen samanya kavita samajhne wali pai gayin, jo dikhata hai ki purane samay me bhi striyon me shiksha ki ek parampara maujud thi.

qe: In the area to the west of the Kosi river, about twenty women were able to correspond in which language, described as devabhasa or the language of the gods?
qh: कोसी नदी के पश्चिम के क्षेत्र में लगभग बीस महिलाएँ किस भाषा में पत्र-व्यवहार कर सकती थीं, जिसे देवभाषा या देवताओं की भाषा कहा गया?
e: Unnisvin sadi ke madhya me mahilaon ki shiksha ki sthiti ko samajhne me aise kai vivechan sahayak hote hain. Kosi nadi ke pashchim ke kshetra me lagbhag bees mahilaen aisi thi jo devabhasha yaani 'devtaon ki bhasha' kahi jaane wali bhasha me patra-vyavahar yaani chitthi likh kar sampark kar sakti thin. Us samay Hindi ko devabhasha ke roop me bhi kaha jaata tha, kyunki yah bhasha aam janta tatha gaon ke logon ki bhasha thi. Iske alava Purnea zile me 433 mahilaen samanya kavita samajhti thin tatha Shahabad me kuchh mahilaen chitthiyan padh-likh sakti thin. In tathyon se pata chalta hai ki unnisvin sadi ke prarambh me hi Bharat ke vibhinn bhagon me stri-shiksha ki ek seemit parampara maujud thi, jise aage chalkar angrezi shiksha ke daur me sansthaon dwara ek nayi disha mili. Exam point: Kosi nadi ke pashchim ke kshetra me lagbhag bees mahilaen Hindi bhasha me, jise devabhasha kaha jaata tha, patra-vyavahar kar sakti thin.

qe: In 1875-6 it was reported that about a dozen girls were at school in boys' pathshalas in every district, except which two districts?
qh: 1875-6 में बताया गया कि प्रत्येक जिले की लड़कों की पाठशालाओं में लगभग एक दर्जन लड़कियाँ पढ़ती थीं, किन दो जिलों को छोड़कर?
e: 1875-6 me mahilaon ki shiksha ke vishay me yah dekha gaya ki logon ka sahi jhukav kya hai; pratyek jile ki ladkon ki pathshalaon me lagbhag ek darjan ladkiyan padhti thin, keval Patna tatha Champaran zilon ke atirikt. Patna me kuchh mahila-shiksha aisi thi jo sarkari riport yaani returns me nazar nahi aati thi - udaharan ke liye Dinapore me ek darzi kaam karte-karte das Mussalman ladkiyon ko padhata tha. Isi tarah Lai me, jo Bihta railway station ke paas hai, ek buzurg mahila tees ya chalis ladkiyon ko Hindi padhati thin tatha wah kshetra ke log jile me sabse aage mane jaate the. In udaharanon se pata chalta hai ki mahila shiksha uchcha vargon tatha shahron se aage gaonon tatha nichle vargon me bhi dhire-dhire pahunch rahi thi. Exam point: 1875-6 me keval Patna tatha Champaran zilon ke atirikt har jile ki ladkon ki pathshalaon me lagbhag ek darjan ladkiyan padhti thin.

qe: At Lai, near the Bihta railway station, who taught thirty or forty girls Hindi, the people of that part being the most advanced in the district?
qh: बिहता रेलवे स्टेशन के पास लाई में कौन तीस या चालीस लड़कियों को हिंदी पढ़ाता था, जहाँ के लोग जिले में सबसे आगे माने जाते थे?
e: Patna zile me mahila shiksha ke kuchh jaagte hue udaharan mile. Lai naam ke sthan par, jo Bihta railway station ke paas hai, ek buzurg mahila yaani old woman tees ya chalis ladkiyon ko Hindi padhati thin. Us kshetra ke log jile me sabse aage yaani advanced maane jaate the tatha Deputy tatha Sub-Inspector ka vishwas tha ki Kayastha, Rajput, Brahmana tatha Baniya jaatiyon ki tees pratishat mahilaon ko kuchh shiksha prapt thi; kuchh mahilaen to Ramayana tak padhti thin. Isi tarah Gaya me kuchh amir log apni betiyon ko naama likhna sikhate the tatha kuchh varsh pehle is jile ke Deo ki ek ladki varnakular scholarship pariksha me safal hui thi. Yeh udaharan dikhate hain ki sarkari schoolon ke atirikt anopcharik yaani informal vyavasthaon se bhi mahilaon ki shiksha ho rahi thi. Exam point: Bihta railway station ke paas Lai me ek buzurg mahila tees-chalis ladkiyon ko Hindi padhati thin tatha wahan Kayastha, Rajput, Brahmana tatha Baniya jaatiyon ki lagbhag tees pratishat mahilaon ko kuchh shiksha thi.

qe: What proportion of the women of the Kayastha, Rajput, Brahmana and Baniya castes of a pat of the Patna district were believed to have some education in 1875-6?
qh: 1875-6 में पटना जिले के एक भाग की कायस्थ, राजपूत, ब्राह्मण तथा बनिया जातियों की महिलाओं में से कितने भाग को कुछ शिक्षा प्राप्त माना गया?
e: 1875-6 ke vivran me mahila shiksha ke kuchh ashcharyajanak tathy mile. Patna zile ke Lai kshetra ke aas-paas, jahan ke log jile me sabse aage maane jaate the, Deputy tatha Sub-Inspector ka vishwas tha ki Kayastha, Rajput, Brahmana tatha Baniya jaatiyon ki tees pratishat mahilaon ko kuchh shiksha prapt thi tatha kuchh mahilaen Ramayana tak padh leti thin. Isi tarah Gaya me kuchh amir log apni betiyon ko nama likhna sikhate the. In tathyon se pata chalta hai ki unchi jaatiyon me mahila shiksha ke prati ek rujhan banna shuru ho gaya tha, halanki yah sankhya kul mahila jansankhya ke hisab se bahut chhoti thi tatha aisi shiksha mukhya roop se padhne-likhne tak hi seemit thi. Exam point: Patna zile ke ek kshetra me Kayastha, Rajput, Brahmana tatha Baniya jaatiyon ki lagbhag tees pratishat mahilaon ko kuchh shiksha prapt maana gaya tha, tatha kuchh mahilaen Ramayana padh leti thin.

qe: At Bettiah, a khidmutgar taught twelve girls which set of subjects, besides the multiplication table?
qh: बेतिया में एक खिदमतगार बारह लड़कियों को पहाड़े के अतिरिक्त और कौन-से विषय पढ़ाता था?
oh: हिंदी, फारसी, पाक-कला तथा टोकरी बनाना
e: Champaran zile ke Bettiah kshetra me mahila shiksha ke kuchh dilchasp udaharan mile. Bettiah me ek khidmutgar yaani attendant barah ladkiyon ko Hindi, Persian, pahada yaani multiplication table, pak-kala yaani cooking tatha tokri banana yaani basket-making sikhata tha. Isi kshetra me kai Kurmis apni ladkiyon ko Kaithi sikhate the tatha yahan tak ki Ramayana padhne tak ki shiksha dete the; unhone ek school kholne ke liye aavedan bhi kiya tha. Kaithi ek desi lipi hai, jisme aam taur par gaon ke log hisab-kitab tatha patra-vyavahar likha karte the. In udaharanon se saaf hota hai ki unnisvin sadi ke antim hisse me gaonon tatha kisan vargon me bhi ladkiyon ki shiksha ke liye vyaktigat tatha samudayik prayas shuru ho gaye the, halanki yeh prayas abhi sankhya me kam tatha bikhre hue the. Exam point: Bettiah me ek khidmutgar barah ladkiyon ko Hindi, Persian, pahada, pak-kala tatha tokri banane ki shiksha deta tha, jabki Champaran ke kai Kurmis apni ladkiyon ko Kaithi tatha Ramayana padhate the.

qe: The Hartog Committee of 1929 observed that there were nearly two and a half million girls of school-going age in Bihar, but only how many girls were under instruction in recognized institutions?
qh: 1929 की हार्टोग समिति ने देखा कि बिहार में स्कूल जाने योग्य आयु की लगभग ढाई लाख लड़कियाँ थीं, लेकिन मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थाओं में कितनी लड़कियाँ शिक्षा प्राप्त कर रही थीं?
e: Beesvin sadi ke pehle dashakon me mahila shiksha ke kshetra me kaafi prayas hue, lekin sthiti abhi bhi bahut peechhe thi. 1929 me Hartog Committee yaani Hartog samiti ne Bihar ke sandarbh me kaha ki yahan school jaane yogya aayu ki lagbhag dhai million yaani pachchis lakh ladkiyan thi, lekin manyata prapt sansthaon me padhne wali ladkiyon ki sankhya keval 116,000 thi. Inme se 110,000 se adhik ladkiyan keval prarambhik schoolon me thi tatha lagbhag poori tarah se do sabse nichle classes tak hi seemit thi. Uchcha shiksha ke kshetra me praant vishesh roop se peechhe tha tatha middle star se upar keval kuchh sau log, mukhya roop se Isai tatha Hindu, the. Is vivran se pata chalta hai ki us samay mahila shiksha ka vistaar bahut dhire tatha ashantulit tha tatha aage bahut bada kaam karna baki tha. Exam point: Hartog samiti ne 1929 me kaha ki Bihar me school jaane yogya aayu ki lagbhag dhai million ladkiyon me se keval 116,000 ladkiyan manyata prapt sansthaon me padh rahi thin, jinme 110,000 se adhik prarambhik schoolon me thi.

qe: In 1921 the percentage of literacy among the women of the Province was only 0.6; what was it in 1911?
qh: 1921 में प्रांत की महिलाओं में साक्षरता का प्रतिशत केवल 0.6 था; 1911 में यह कितना था?
e: Saksharta yaani literacy ka arth hai kisi vyakti ka padh tatha likh pana; jansankhya ganana me aise vyakti ko sakshar maana jaata hai. Beesvin sadi ke prarambh me Bihar me mahilaon ki saksharta ki sthiti bahut hi kharab thi. 1911 me praant me mahilaon ki saksharta ka pratishat keval 0.4 tha tatha 1921 me yah badh kar kul 0.6 pratishat hua. Yeh vriddhi halanki bahut chhoti thi, kyunki us samay ladkiyon ke liye schoolon ki sankhya tatha shikshikaon ki uplabdhata, dono hi bahut seemit thi; purdah pratha ke karan bhi mahilaon ka bahar padhne jaana kathin tha. Isi karan aage chalkar mahila shiksha ke liye vishesh yojnayen tatha sansthaen banayi gayin, jisse beesvin sadi ke madhya me mahila shiksha ke kshetra me tezi se badhotri hui. Exam point: Bihar tatha Orissa praant me mahila saksharta keval 0.4 pratishat (1911) se badh kar 0.6 pratishat (1921) hui thi, jo us samay mahila shiksha ki bahut kamzor sthiti darshati hai.

qe: After a fall between 1920-1 and 1923-4, the number of girls in girls' schools and colleges rose to how many, while girls in boys' schools and colleges numbered 40,419?
qh: 1920-1 से 1923-4 के बीच गिरावट के बाद लड़कियों के विद्यालयों तथा महाविद्यालयों में पढ़ने वाली लड़कियों की संख्या कितनी हो गई, जबकि लड़कों के विद्यालयों तथा महाविद्यालयों में लड़कियों की संख्या 40,419 थी?
e: 1920-1 se 1923-4 ke beech mahila shiksha me ek baar girti dikhi - is avadhi me college tatha schoolon me padhne wali ladkiyon ki sankhya ghat gayi. Lekin iske agle varsh me wapas vriddhi hui; us samay ladkiyon ke schoolon tatha collegeon me padhne wali ladkiyon ki sankhya badh kar 70,779 ho gayi tatha ladkon ke schoolon tatha collegeon me padhne wali ladkiyon ki sankhya 40,419 thi. Is vriddhi ke saath-saath aage chalkar mahilaon ke liye collegeon ki sthapna hui, schoolon ki sankhya badhi tatha sahasikshaa yaani co-education bhi tezi se phaili. Is tarah rashtriya andolan tatha samajik jagriti ke kaaran mahila shiksha ko ek nayi gati mili tatha pashchatya dhang ki mahila shiksha dhire-dhire ek jan-andolan ka roop lene lagi. Exam point: 1923-4 ke baad wapasi vriddhi me ladkiyon ke schoolon tatha collegeon me padhne wali ladkiyon ki sankhya 70,779 ho gayi thi, jabki ladkon ke schoolon tatha collegeon me 40,419 ladkiyan padh rahi thin.
